| # Flashing SW onto RC4x {#flashing-sw-onto-rc4x-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                   |                                                                                                                                                                |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The merged hex file generated from CODESYS which contains ASW + BODAS-RTS can be flashed using BODAS-service.

For the instruction on how to install and flash BODAS-service - refer to the BODAS-service user manual.
